text: おれは　たいりょく　ないけど　でんきの　あつかいを　かわれて　ここに　きたのだ！

structure.jp: たいりょく　ないけど
でんきの　あつかいを　かわれて
structure.en: my handling of electricity was valued, and

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two halves with 'but'. たいりょく ないけど = 'I don't have stamina, but'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: かう 'buy' becomes かわれる 'be bought', here meaning his skill was thought highly of by someone. The て ending leads on to what happened because of it. あつかいを かわれて = 'my handling was valued, so'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end gives the line an explaining tone: 'the fact is...'. ここに きたのだ = 'that's why I came here'.
